usedFor: Contact Form 7 collects website form entries, and HubSpot receives them as records through “Create Contact” and “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Contact Form 7, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Every submission is a possible lead, and the action creates the contact.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so the form needs an email field mapped into it.
